hardeningAdded: Devanagari combining marks are preserved during evidence normalization.
Hindi number words from zero through ten plus half are deterministic evidence.
A catalogue alias shared by multiple products is rejected as ambiguous instead of selecting database order.
The versioned corpus is a required npm run test:ai-safety release gate and cannot silently shrink below 15 cases.
limitations: This is deterministic first-party corpus evidence, not proof against every novel model output.
Production shadow traffic, labeled false-accept/false-reject outcomes and model-change canaries remain outstanding.
Raw audio and unredacted customer data must not be retained to obtain those metrics.
